_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Say simbolo mo '{symbol}'.
Ikaw la takken turns na natangtan na simbolo mo ed saray 5x5 a papan balet line na upaya.
Lines pwede la horizontal, vertical, o diagonal.
Isumite yo move yo using na format '[4]' balet marka cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mali a pormat na galaw. Usaren yo so '[cell]' no sika cell et 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Sala a numero na cell: {cell}. Kinmapo la between 0 and {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Say manlalaban {player_id} et nanggawa na aliwan valid a galaw.

game_action.placed: Say Player {player_id} natangtan na saray simbolo ({symbol}) ed field ({row}, {col}).
